title: Spinlock Guard
goal: Build a lock acquisition loop using atomic compare_exchange_weak.
hints: `compare_exchange_weak` is idiomatic inside spin loops because it can fail spuriously yielding better performance on ARM.
The while loop should continue spinning as long as the atomic exchange fails (returns `Err`).
explanation: `compare_exchange_weak` is preferred inside retry loops because it can fail spuriously yielding better performance on architectures like ARM. When `compare_exchange_weak` successfully acquires the lock, it returns `Ok`, so `is_err()` evaluates to `false` and terminates the loop. Using `is_ok()` causes callers to exit prematurely without waiting when another thread holds the lock. `unwrap_err()` panics on `Ok`. Methods `swap` and `store` take 2 arguments instead of 4, producing compiler error `E0061`.
